strategy: Read-only presentation lookup by canonical USA text/pointer. Keep USA native instructions, scenarios, prices, AI, clocks and balance; never replace runtime ROM with the European or fan-translated binary.

searchScope: All37 named native resource-index entries in each supplied ROM: no language/flag/country resource names.
Existing full native Main/Options/house-picker source-art inventory has no country-language selector; three faction banners are house emblems, not country flags.
countryFlags.limitation: This is a bounded resource/UI inventory, not semantic identification of every opaque graphics byte. It does not prove an arbitrary unused bitmap could never resemble a flag.
countryFlags.shipping: No native country flags are exported or claimed. Any English/Russian picker flag must be an explicitly authored matching-style interface symbol.

analysisBoundary.reason: Advertised REA raw-binary architecture schema lacks68000; no ROM was opened under a false architecture. Matching pinned original generated consumers and explicit format-aware byte/pixel parsers provide the extraction evidence.

countryFlags.reason: No native country-language flags in the parsed resource/UI inventory; faction banners are not country flags.
